```{r}
#| message: false
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)


# Data base
create_sqlite_con_precompute <- function(
  db_path = "../data/notas-pau.db",
  flags = RSQLite::SQLITE_RO,
  pragmas = c(
    journal_mode = "WAL",
    busy_timeout = 5000,
    synchronous = "NORMAL",
    cache_size = 10000
  )
) {
  con <- DBI::dbConnect(
    drv = RSQLite::SQLite(),
    dbname = db_path,
    flags = flags
  )

  for (i in seq_along(pragmas)) {
    key <- names(pragmas)[i]
    val <- pragmas[[i]]
    stmt <- sprintf(
      "PRAGMA %s = %s;",
      key,
      if (is.character(val)) val else as.character(val)
    )
    try(DBI::dbExecute(con, stmt), silent = TRUE)
  }

  con
}


con <- create_sqlite_con_precompute()
```


```{r}
raw <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "SELECT name, year, type_id FROM high_school_marks JOIN high_schools ON  high_school_marks.high_school_id = high_schools.id  WHERE call = 0"
) |>
  distinct(name, year, type_id)

year_cols <- sort(unique(raw$year))
n_years <- length(year_cols)

matrix <- raw |>
  mutate(value = "x") |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = year,
    values_from = value,
    values_fill = ""
  ) |>
  mutate(
    n_present = rowSums(across(all_of(as.character(year_cols))) == "x"),
    todas = if_else(n_present == n_years, "x", "")
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(n_present), name)

display <- matrix |>
  select(name, all_of(as.character(year_cols)), todas)

display_render <- display |>
  mutate(across(-name, ~ ifelse(.x == "x", "✓", "")))

kable(
  display_render,
  booktabs = TRUE,
  longtable = TRUE,
  align = c("l", rep("c", n_years), "c"),
  col.names = c("Centro", as.character(year_cols), "Todas"),
  caption = "Presencia de los centros por año (columna final: presente en todas las convocatorias)"
) %>%
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("repeat_header", "striped"),
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"),
    full_width = FALSE,
    font_size = 8,
    position = "center"
  ) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "9cm", bold = TRUE) %>%
  column_spec(ncol(display_render), bold = TRUE) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)
```

```{r}
resumen <- matrix |>
  mutate(estado = if_else(todas == "x", "En todas", "No en todas")) |>
  group_by(type_id, estado) |>
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = estado, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
  mutate(
    type_id = as.character(type_id),
    total = `En todas` + `No en todas`,
    Resumen = paste0(
      "En todas: ", `En todas`, " (", round(100 * `En todas` / total, 1), "%)",
      " / No en todas: ", `No en todas`, " (", round(100 * `No en todas` / total, 1), "%)"
    )
  ) |>
  select(type_id, Resumen)

global <- matrix |>
  summarise(
    en_todas = sum(todas == "x"),
    no_en_todas = sum(todas != "x")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    type_id = "Global",
    total = en_todas + no_en_todas,
    Resumen = paste0(
      "En todas: ", en_todas, " (", round(100 * en_todas / total, 1), "%)",
      " / No en todas: ", no_en_todas, " (", round(100 * no_en_todas / total, 1), "%)"
    )
  ) |>
  select(type_id, Resumen)

resumen_final <- dplyr::bind_rows(resumen, global)

kable(
  resumen_final,
  booktabs = TRUE,
  align = c("l", "l"),
  col.names = c("Tipo de centro", "Resumen"),
  caption = "Centros presentes en todas las convocatorias por tipo y global"
) %>%
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("hold_position", "striped"),
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "center"
  ) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) %>%
  row_spec(nrow(resumen_final), bold = TRUE)
```
